θεωρία, -ας, ἡ (see: θεωρέω), [in LXX: Dan LXX 5:7, 2Ma.5:26 2Mac 15:12, 3Ma.5:24 * ;] 1. a viewing. 2. = θεώρημα, a spectacle, sight: [[luke 23 48|Luk.23:48]] (both senses in cl.).† (AS)
Θήκη, -ης, ἡ (τίθημι), [in LXX: [[exodus 25 27|Exo.25:27]] (בַּיִת), [[isaiah 6 13|Isa.6:13 3:26]] * ;] a receptacle, chest, case: of the sheath of a sword, [[john 18 11|Jhn.18:11.]]† (AS)

θηλάζω (θηλή, a breast), [in LXX chiefly for יָנַק hi. ;] 1. of the mother, to suckle: [[matthew 24 19|Mat.24:19]], [[mark 13 17|Mrk.13:17]], [[luke 21 23|Luk.21:23]]. 2. Of the young, to suck: [[matthew 21 16|Mat.21:16;]] μαστούς, [[luke 11 27|Luk.11:27]] (cf. [[job 3 12|Job.3:12]], [[song-of-solomon 8 1|Sng.8:1]], al.).† (AS)

θῆλυς, -εια, -υ [in LXX chiefly for נְקֵבָה ;] female: as subst., ἡ θ., a female, a woman: [[romans 1 26|Rom.1:26-27;]] τὸ θ.., [[matthew 19 4|Mat.19:4]], [[mark 10 6|Mrk.10:6]], [[galatians 3 28|Gal.3:28]].† (AS)

θήρα, -ας, ἡ [in LXX for צַיִד, טָרַף, רֶשֶׁת, and cogn. forms ;] 1. a hunting, chase (Hat., Xen., al.). 2. prey, game (c1.). 3. As in [[psalms 35 8|Psa.35:8]] = רֶשֶׁת, a net: [[romans 11 9|Rom.11:9]] (but see Thayer, see word).† (AS)
θηρεύω (θήρα), [in LXX for צוּד, etc. ;] to hunt, ensnare, catch: metaphorically, [[luke 11 54|Luk.11:54.]]† (AS)
θηριομαχέω, -ῶ (θηρίον, μάχομαι), to fight with wild beasts (Diod., al.): [[1-corinthians 15 32|1Co.15:32.]]† (AS)

θηρίον, -ου, τό (dimin. of θήρ), [in LXX chiefly for חַי ;] a wild beast, beast: [[mark 1 13|Mrk.1:13]], [[acts 11 6|Act.11:6 28:4-5]], [[titus 1 12|Tit.1:12]], [[hebrews 12 20|Heb.12:20]], [[james 3 7|Jas.3:7]], [[revelation 6 8|Rev.6:8]]; of Antichrist, [[revelation 11 7|Rev.11:7, 13-19]].† (AS)

θησαυρίζω [in LXX for צָפַן, etc. ;] to lay up, store up: of riches, [[james 5 3|Jas.5:3;]] id. with dative of person(s), [[luke 12 21|Luk.12:21]], [[2-corinthians 12 14|2Co.12:14]]; with accusative of thing(s), [[1-corinthians 16 2|1Co.16:2;]] θησαυροὺς ἑαυτῷ, [[matthew 6 19|Mat.6:19-20;]] pass., [[2-peter 3 7|2Pe.3:7;]] metaphorically, ὀργὴν ἑαντῷ, [[romans 2 5|Rom.2:5]] (cf. [[proverbs 1 18|Pro.1:18]], Pss. Pss.Sol 9:9).† (AS)

θησαυρός, -οῦ, ὁ (τίθημι), [in LXX chiefly for אוֹצָר ;] 1. a place of safe keeping; (a) a casket: [[matthew 2 11|Mat.2:11;]] (b) a treasury (1Ma.3:29 and frequently in cl.); (with) a storehouse ([[nehemiah 13 12|Neh.13:12]], [[deuteronomy 28 12|Deu.28:12]], al.): [[matthew 13 52|Mat.13:52]]; metaphorically, of the soul, [[matthew 12 35|Mat.12:35;]] τ. καρδίας, [[luke 6 45|Luk.6:45]] 2. a treasure: [[matthew 6 18|Mat.6:18-21 13:44]], [[luke 12 33|Luk.12:33-34]], [[hebrews 11 26|Heb.11:26]]; θ. ἐν οὐρανῷ (see Dalman, Words, 206 ff.), [[matthew 19 21|Mat.19:21]], [[mark 10 21|Mrk.10:21]], [[luke 18 22|Luk.18:22]]; of the knowledge of God through Christ, [[2-corinthians 4 7|2Co.4:7;]] τ. σοφίας κ. γνώσεως, [[colossians 2 3|Col.2:3.]]† (AS)

θιγγάνω [in LXX for נָגַע, [[exodus 19 12|Exo.19:12]] * ;] 1. to touch, handle: [[colossians 2 21|Col.2:21]], [[hebrews 12 20|Heb.12:20]]" (LXX) . 2. to injure (like Heb. נָגַע, and as in Eur., Iph. Aul., 1351): with genitive, [[hebrews 11 28|Heb.11:28.]]† SYN.: see: ἅπτω (AS)

θλίβω [in LXX chiefly (ὁ θλίβων, ) for צוּר ;] to press: with accusative of person(s), [[mark 3 9|Mrk.3:9;]] ὁδὸς τεθλιμμένη, a narrow (compressed) way, [[matthew 7 14|Mat.7:14.]] Metaphorical (as frequently in LXX), to oppress, afflict, distress: with accusative of person(s), [[2-thessalonians 1 6|2Th.1:6;]] pass. (Vg., tribulor, tribulation em patior), [[2-corinthians 1 6|2Co.1:6 4:8 7:5]], [[1-thessalonians 3 4|1Th.3:4]], [[2-thessalonians 1 7|2Th.1:7]], [[1-timothy 5 10|1Ti.5:10]], [[hebrews 11 37|Heb.11:37]] (cf. ἀπο-, συν-θλίβω).† (AS)

θλίψις (LTr., θλῖψις), -εως, ἡ (θλίβω), [in LXX for צָרָה, etc. ;] pressure (Arist.). In LXX and NT metaphorically, tribulation, affliction, distress: [[matthew 24 9|Mat.24:9, 21 24:29]], [[mark 13 19|Mrk.13:19, 24]], [[john 16 21|Jhn.16:21]], [[acts 7 11|Act.7:11 11:19]], [[romans 12 12|Rom.12:12]], [[2-corinthians 1 4|2Co.1:4 1:8 4:17 6:4 7:4 8:2 8:13]], [[philippians 4 14|Php.4:14]], [[2-thessalonians 1 6|2Th.1:6]], [[james 1 27|Jas.1:27]], [[revelation 1 9|Rev.1:9 2:9, 22 7:14]]; with ἀνάγκη (which see), [[1-thessalonians 3 7|1Th.3:7;]] στενοχωρία (which from the order of the words would appear to be the stronger term), [[romans 2 9|Rom.2:9 8:35]]; διωγμός, [[matthew 13 21|Mat.13:21]], [[mark 4 17|Mrk.4:17]], [[2-thessalonians 1 4|2Th.1:4]]; θ. ἔχω, [[john 16 33|Jhn.16:33]], [[1-corinthians 7 23|1Co.7:23]], [[revelation 2 10|Rev.2:10]]; ἔρχεσθαι ἐπί, [[acts 7 11|Act.7:11;]] ἐν θλίψει [[1-thessalonians 1 6|1Th.1:6;]] pl., [[acts 7 10|Act.7:10 14:22 20:28]], [[romans 5 3|Rom.5:3]], [[ephesians 3 13|Eph.3:13]], [[1-thessalonians 3 3|1Th.3:3]], [[hebrews 10 33|Heb.10:33]]; τ. Χριστοῦ, [[colossians 1 24|Col.1:24;]] θ. τῆς καρδίας, [[2-corinthians 2 4|2Co.2:4;]] θ. ἐγείρειν, [[philippians 1 17|Php.1:17.]]† SYN.: ἀνάγκη, διωγμός, στενοχωρία (see supr., and cf. Tr., Syn, iv; Lft., Notes, 45) (AS)

θνήσκω [in LXX chiefly for מוּת ;] to die; pf. (M, Pr., 114), to be dead: [[matthew 2 20|Mat.2:20]], [[mark 15 44|Mrk.15:44]], [[luke 7 12|Luk.7:12 8:49]], [[john 11 44|Jhn.11:44 19:33]], [[acts 14 19|Act.14:19 25:19]]; metaphorically, of spiritual death, [[1-timothy 5 6|1Ti.5:6]] (cf. ἀπο-, συν-απο-θνήσκω).† (AS)

θνητός, -ή, -όν (θνήσκω), [in LXX: [[proverbs 3 13|Pro.3:13 20:24]] (אָדָם), [[job 30 23|Job.30:23]] (חַי), [[isaiah 51 12|Isa.51:12]] (מוּת), Wis.9:14 15:17, 2Ma.9:12, 3Ma.3:29 * ;] subject to death, mortal: [[romans 6 12|Rom.6:12 8:11]], [[1-corinthians 15 53|1Co.15:53-54]], [[2-corinthians 4 11|2Co.4:11 5:4]].† (AS)

θορυβέω, -ῶ (θόρυβος), [in LXX: [[nahum 2 3|Nam.2:3]] (רָעַל ho.), Dan LXX 8:17 (בָּעַת ni.), [[judges 3 26|Jdg.3:26]], Wis.18:19, Sir.40:6 * ;] 1. to make a noise or uproar: mid., of loud and ostentatious lamentation, [[matthew 9 23|Mat.9:23]], [[mark 5 39|Mrk.5:39]], [[acts 20 10|Act.20:10]]. 2. Trans., to trouble, throw into confusion: τ. πόλιν, [[acts 17 5|Act.17:5.]]† (AS)

θόρυβος, -ου, ὁ [in LXX for הָמוֹן, etc. ;] a noise, uproar, tumult, as of an excited mob: [[matthew 26 5|Mat.26:5 27:24]], [[mark 14 2|Mrk.14:2]], [[acts 20 1|Act.20:1 21:34 24:18]]; of mourners, = ὄχλος θορυβούμενος, [[mark 5 38|Mrk.5:38.]]† (AS)
θραύω [in LXX for 1,21 ([[deuteronomy 28 33|Deu.28:33]], [[isaiah 42 4|Isa.42:4 58:6]]), etc. ;] to break in pieces, shatter; metaphorically, to break down: [[luke 4 18|Luk.4:18]] (LXX).† (AS)
θρέμμα, -τος, τό (τρέφω) 1. a nurseling, esp. of animals (Eur., Plat., al.). 2. cattle: [[john 4 12|Jhn.4:12.]]† (AS)

θρηνέω, -ῶ (θρῆνος), [in LXX chiefly for יָלַל hi., also for קַיִן pit., etc. ;] 1. intrans., to lament, wail: [[matthew 11 17|Mat.11:17]], [[luke 7 32|Luk.7:32]], [[john 16 20|Jhn.16:20]]. 2. Trans., to bewail: with accusative of person(s), [[luke 23 27|Luk.23:27.]]† SYN.: κλαίω, κόπτομαι, λυπέομαι, πενθέω (see Tr., Syn., lxv). (AS)
θρῆνος, -ου, ὁ [in LXX chiefly for קִינָה ;] a lamentation: [[matthew 2 18|Mat.2:18]], Rec.† (AS)

θρησκεία (-κία, T), -ας, ἡ (θρῆσκος), [in LXX: Wis.14:18, 27, Sir.22:5 A, 4Ma.5:6 4Mac 5:13 * ;] religion in its external aspect (MM, Exp., xv), worship: [[acts 26 5|Act.26:5]], [[james 1 26|Jas.1:26-27]]; θ. τῶν ἀγγέλων, [[colossians 2 18|Col.2:18.]]† SYN.: see: θρῆσκος (AS)

θρῆσκος (-κός, WH), -ον, ό religious, careful of the outward forms of divine service (see previous word)): [[james 1 26|Jas.1:26.]]† SYN.: εὐσεβής, θεοσεβής, δεισιδαίμων (see Tr., Syn., § xlviii) (AS)

θριαμβεύω (θρίαμβος, 1. a festal hymn to Bacchus. 2. The Roman triumphus), 1. to triumph (and rarely, with accusative, to triumph over; so perh. [[colossians 2 15|Col.2:15]], but see infr.). 2. to lead in triumph: with accusative of person(s), [[2-corinthians 2 14|2Co.2:14;]] hence, generally, to make a spectacle or show of: [[colossians 2 15|Col.2:15]] (but see supr.; cf. MM, Exp., xv; and esp. Field, Notes, 181).† (AS)

θρίξ, τριχός, ἡ [in LXX chiefly for שֵׂעָר ;] hair; (a) of the head: [[matthew 3 4|Mat.3:4 5:36 10:30]], [[luke 7 38|Luk.7:38, 44 12:7 21:18]], [[john 11 2|Jhn.11:2 12:3]], [[acts 27 34|Act.27:34]], [[1-peter 3 3|1Pe.3:3]], [[revelation 1 14|Rev.1:14]]; (b) of animals: [[mark 1 6|Mrk.1:6]], [[revelation 9 8|Rev.9:8]].† (AS)

θροέω, -ῶ (θρόος, a noise, tumult), [in LXX: [[song-of-solomon 5 4|Sng.5:4]] (הָמָה * ;] in cl., 1. to cry aloud, make an outcry. 2. to utter aloud. 3. In NT (and LXX), pass., to be troubled, as by an alarm: [[matthew 24 6|Mat.24:6]], [[mark 13 7|Mrk.13:7]], [[luke 24 37|Luk.24:37]] (WH, mg.), [[2-thessalonians 2 2|2Th.2:2]] (cf. Kennedy, Sources, 126).† (AS)
θρόμβος, -ου, ὁ (τρέφω, in primary sense to thicken), a lump, a clot of blood (DCG, ii, 685b): αἵματος, [[luke 22 44|Luk.22:44]] (WH, R, mg. omit the passage, see WH, App., 64 ff.).† (AS)

θρόνος, -ου, ὁ [in LXX chiefly for כִּסֵּא, [[exodus 11 5|Exo.11:5]], al. ;] in Hom., a seat, chair. Later, a throne, chair of state, seat of authority; of kings: metaphorically, of God, [[matthew 5 34|Mat.5:34]], [[acts 7 49|Act.7:49]]" (LXX), [[revelation 1 4|Rev.1:4]], al.; by meton., for kingly power, sovereignty, [[luke 1 32|Luk.1:32, 52]], [[acts 2 30|Act.2:30]]; for an angelic hierarchy, [[colossians 1 16|Col.1:16;]] of Christ, [[matthew 19 28|Mat.19:28]], [[revelation 3 21|Rev.3:21]], al.; of Satan, [[revelation 2 13|Rev.2:13;]] τ. θηρίου, [[revelation 16 10|Rev.16:10;]] of the Apostles, [[matthew 19 28|Mat.19:28]], [[luke 22 30|Luk.22:30]], cf. [[revelation 20 4|Rev.20:4;]] of πρεσβύτεροι, [[revelation 4 4|Rev.4:4 11:16]] (on θ. τῆς χάριτος, [[hebrews 4 16|Heb.4:16]], see Westc., in l; Deiss., BS, 135) (AS)
Θυάτειρα, -ων, τά (-ας, ἡ, [[revelation 1 11|Rev.1:11]] L; cf. WH, App., 156) Thyatira, a city of Lydia: [[acts 16 14|Act.16:14]], [[revelation 1 11|Rev.1:11 2:18, 24]].† (AS)

θυγάτηρ, -τρός, ἡ (for use of vocat., cf. M, Pr., 71; WH, App, 158), [in LXX for בַּת ([[genesis 5 4|Gen.5:4]], al.), exc. [[judges 21 14|Jdg.21:14]] B, [[2-chronicles 21 17|2Ch.21:17]] (אִשָּׁה ;] daughter: [[matthew 9 18|Mat.9:18 10:35, 37 14:6 15:22, 28]], [[mark 5 35|Mrk.5:35 6:22 7:26, 29]], [[luke 2 36|Luk.2:36 8:42, 49 12:53]], [[acts 2 17|Act.2:17]]" (LXX) [[acts 7 21|Act.7:21 21:9]], [[hebrews 11 24|Heb.11:24]]. [[ruth 2 2|Rut.2:2, 22]] al.): [[matthew 9 22|Mat.9:22]], [[mark 5 34|Mrk.5:34]], [[luke 8 48|Luk.8:48]]; (b) metaphorically: sc. κυρίου, [[2-corinthians 6 18|2Co.6:18]] (cf. [[isaiah 43 6|Isa.43:6]]); (with) of posterity: θ. Ἀαρών, [[luke 1 5|Luk.1:5;]] Ἀβραάμ, [[luke 13 16|Luk.13:16]] (cf. [[isaiah 16 2|Isa.16:2]], 4Ma.15:28, al); (d) of habita­tion: θ. Σιών, Ἱερουσαλήμ, [[matthew 21 5|Mat.21:5]] (LXX), [[luke 23 28|Luk.23:28]], [[john 12 15|Jhn.12:15]] (cf. [[isaiah 1 8|Isa.1:8]], [[zechariah 9 9|Zec.9:9]], al.).† (AS)
θυγάτριον, -ου, τό (dimin. of θυγάτηρ), a little daughter, a term of endearment used in late Gk. (cf. B1., § 27, 4): [[mark 5 23|Mrk.5:23 7:25]].† (AS)

θύελλα, -ης, ἡ (θύω), [in LXX [[deuteronomy 4 11|Deu.4:11 5:22]] (עֲרָפֶל), [[exodus 10 22|Exo.10:22]] * ;] (poët. in cl.), a hurricane, cyclone, whirlwind: [[hebrews 12 18|Heb.12:18.]]† SYN.: λαίλαψ (which see) (AS)

θύινος (usually θύϊνος, as Rec.), -η, -ον (θυία, θύα, an African aromatic tree, with ornamentally veined wood of varying colour, = Lat. citrinus), [in Sm.: [[1-kings 10 11|3Ki.10:11]] (אַלְמֻגִּים)* ;] thyme: ξύλον, [[revelation 18 12|Rev.18:12]] (Diosc.).† (AS)

θυμίαμα, -τος, τό (θυμιάω), [in LXX chiefly for קְטֹרֶת ;] fragrant stuff for burning, incense: ἡ ὥρα τοῦ θ., [[luke 1 10|Luk.1:10;]] θυσιαστήριον τοῦ θ. ([[exodus 30 27|Exo.30:27]], al.), [[luke 1 11|Luk.1:11]]; pl., [[revelation 5 8|Rev.5:8 8:3-4 18:13]].† (AS)

θυμιατήριον, -ου, τό (θυμιάω), [in LXX: [[2-chronicles 26 19|2Ch.26:19]], [[ezekiel 8 11|Eze.8:11]] (קְטֹרֶת), 4Ma.7:11 * ;] 1. as in cl. (Hdt., iv, 162; Thuc., vi, 46) and LXX, a censer: [[hebrews 9 4|Heb.9:4]] (but see infr., and cf. Westc., in l). 2. As in Philo., rer. div., § 46, FlJ, Ant., iv, 2, 4, al., the altar of incense: He, l.with (but see supr. and cf. MM, Exp., xv).† (AS)
θυμιάω, -ῶ (θύω), [in LXX (with -άζω) chiefly for קָטַר pi., hi. ;] to burn incense: [[luke 1 9|Luk.1:9.]]† (AS)
θυμομαέω, -ῶ (θυμός, μάχομαι), to fight desperately, have a hot quarrel: with dative of person(s), [[acts 12 20|Act.12:20.]]† (AS)

[[colossians 3 8|Col.3:8;]] πικρία κ. θ., [[ephesians 4 31|Eph.4:31;]] πλησθῆναι, πλήρης θυμοῦ, [[luke 4 28|Luk.4:28]], [[acts 19 28|Act.19:28]]; θ. ἔχειν, [[revelation 12 12|Rev.12:12;]] οἶνος τ. θυμοῦ τ. πορνείας (cf. θυμόω, -ῶ (θυμός) [in LXX (chiefly in pass.) for חָרָה, אַף חָרָה hith., etc. ;] (no act. in Attic.); pass. (and mid.), to be wroth or very angry: [[matthew 2 16|Mat.2:16.]]† (AS)
